SOFTWARE__XCLIM.sdo:name: xclim
SOFTWARE__XCLIM.sdo:description: xclim is a library for the analysis of climate data. It is designed to work with xarray datasets and follows the CF conventions. It is part of the PyData ecosystem and is built on top of xarray and dask.

SOFTWARE__XARRAY.sdo:name: xarray
SOFTWARE__XARRAY.sdo:description: xarray is an open source project and Python package that makes working with labelled multi-dimensional arrays simple, efficient, and fun!

SOFTWARE__CDO.sdo:name: Climate Data Operators
SOFTWARE__CDO.sdo:description: The Climate Data Operators (CDO) software is a collection of many operators for standard processing of climate and forecast model data.

FUNCTION__CDO_SUB.sdo:name: sub - subtract two fields
FUNCTION__CDO_SUB.sdo:description: This module performs simple arithmetic of two datasets. The number of fields in ifile1 should be the same as in ifile2. One of the input files can contain only one timestep or one variable. The fields in ofile inherit the meta data from ifile1 or ifile2.

FUNCTION__CDO_SELYEAR.sdo:name: selyear - select a year range
FUNCTION__CDO_SELYEAR.sdo:description: This module selects a year range in the input field.

FUNCTION__CDO_TIMMEAN.sdo:name: timmean - time mean
FUNCTION__CDO_TIMMEAN.sdo:description: This module computes the temporal mean of the input field.

FUNCTION__CDO_SELLONLATBOX.sdo:name: sellonlatbox - select a region
FUNCTION__CDO_SELLONLATBOX.sdo:description: This module selects a region in the input field.

FUNCTION__EXTRACT_JAMS_FILES.sdo:name: Extract JAMS files
FUNCTION__EXTRACT_JAMS_FILES.sdo:description: This module extracts JAMS files from a given netCDF file. They are stored as .dat files.

FUNCTION__XARRAY_ARIDITY_INDEX.sdo:name: Aridity index
FUNCTION__XARRAY_ARIDITY_INDEX.sdo:description: This module computes the aridity index.

FUNCTION__XCLIM_EVAPOTRANSPIRATION.sdo:name: Evapotranspiration
FUNCTION__XCLIM_EVAPOTRANSPIRATION.sdo:description: The potential for water evaporation from soil and transpiration by plants if the water supply is sufficient, calculated with a given method.

FUNCTION__XCLIM_WATER_BUDGET.sdo:name: Water budget
FUNCTION__XCLIM_WATER_BUDGET.sdo:description: Precipitation minus potential evapotranspiration as a measure of an approximated surface water budget.

FUNCTION__XCLIM_CONVERT_UNITS.sdo:name: Convert units
FUNCTION__XCLIM_CONVERT_UNITS.sdo:description: Convert a mathematical expression into a value with the same units as a DataArray.

FUNCTION__XCLIM_RATE2AMOUNT.sdo:name: Rate to amount
FUNCTION__XCLIM_RATE2AMOUNT.sdo:description: Convert a rate variable to an amount by multiplying by the sampling period length.

FUNCTION__CDO_YEARSUM.sdo:name: Year sum
FUNCTION__CDO_YEARSUM.sdo:description: This module computes the sum of the input field over a year.

FUNCTION__CDO_SELTIME.sdo:name: Select a time range
FUNCTION__CDO_SELTIME.sdo:description: This module selects a time range in the input field.

FUNCTION__CDO_YEARSUM_SHIFTTIME.sdo:name: Year sum and shift time
FUNCTION__CDO_YEARSUM_SHIFTTIME.sdo:description: This module computes the sum of the input field over a year and shifts the time.

FUNCTION__CDO_SELTIMESTEP.sdo:name: Select a time step
FUNCTION__CDO_SELTIMESTEP.sdo:description: This module selects a time step in the input field.

COLLECTION__CORDEX_CORE_BIAS.sdo:description: CMIP5 is a climate model intercomparison project. This collection contains bias adjusted data.
